news.headline: How to Digitize Cemetery Records: A Complete Guide
Why Every Cemetery Needs Digital Cemetery Management Software
How Much Does Cemetery Mapping Cost?
Digital Cemetery Mapping: What It Is, How It Works, and Why Every Cemetery Should Consider It

paragraphs: Lazarus Cemetery Mapping sells cemetery digitization and digital cemetery mapping to cemeteries, and describes itself as a full service company. The company travels to a cemetery, walks by each and every memorial to confirm burial locations, and scans paper documents on-site. Records are scanned at the cemetery, and an existing database of records can be transferred into the software the company provides.
The mapping is described as precise GPS mapping displaying open, sold, and occupied plots. Photography of headstones, memorials, and columbariums is listed among the services.

One page names church cemeteries, Catholic cemeteries, municipal cemeteries, township cemeteries, historical cemeteries, memorial parks, and private cemeteries among the types of cemeteries that can benefit. Another page addresses readers who manage a small church cemetery or a large municipal or Catholic cemetery, and offers a customized proposal based on the specific project.

quote.text: Lazarus is a full service company. We personally travel to your cemetery, walk by each and every memorial to confirm burial locations, scan paper documents on-site, and provide you with a seamless transition into cemetery software.
